visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a vertically split screen. In the top half, a young man with dark hair and glasses in a black t-shirt and a young woman with bangs in a white t-shirt are seated in gaming chairs against a plain white wall. Both are looking down intently, likely at smartphones. The bottom half displays a high-paced mobile MOBA game interface with glowing purple and red character skill effects. (2) The scene intensifies as the characters in the game engage in complex combat. The female in the top panel reacts with wide-eyed shock and frequent mouth movements, expressing high emotion while leaning toward her device. The background includes the 'Osim' logo on the chairs. In the game panel, health bars deplete, and multiple ability indicators flash across the screen. (3) The footage moves to a celebratory phase. The female player raises her hand to high-five the male player, both displaying wide smiles and laughter. A large, stylized golden 'VICTORY' graphic with wings appears on the bottom game screen, overlaid with sparkling visual effects and secondary text prompts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio initiates with a high-pitched, high-arousal female voice shouting in Mandarin, paired with energetic heroic background music. A series of sharp digital 'clinks' and combat UI effects punctuate the dialogue. The music has a fast tempo with intense percussion. (2) As combat intensifies, the frequency of 'impact' sound effects increases, layering over rapid, breathless Mandarin speech from both a male and female speaker. The spectral balance is bright, emphasizing high-frequency game sounds like spell activations and pings. (3) Upon reaching the conclusion, a loud, sustained cheering vocalization triggers a shift to a triumphant orchestral music swell. The digital sounds resolve into a clean 'Victory' stinger effect, accompanied by high-volume laughter and clapping, ending with a professional studio-grade clarity.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a high-stakes, successful moment in a mobile game (Arena of Valor) and share the authentic, high-arousal emotional reaction of the streamers with their audience.
